lines.en: label halloweenfour5:
scene nikotohahalloween1
: It’s not about that, you fucking moron. It’s-
lines.zh: : 不是那回事，你这白痴。是-

lines.en: : Wait. Your what?
lines.zh: : 等等。你的什么？

lines.en: : {i}I’m organizing an uprising that calls for pants equality between men and women. The fashion industry is attempting to suppress us via the underutilization of pockets. The need for purses ends now, Onee-chan.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}我在组织一场起义，呼吁男女裤装平等。时尚产业正通过不充分使用口袋来压制我们。手提包的时代到此结束，Onee-chan。{/i}

lines.en: : Be careful, Noriko. I made this same mistake when I was your age. You don’t know who you’re messing with right now. This is dangerous.
lines.zh: : 小心点，Noriko。我在你这个年纪犯过一模一样的错。你根本不知道自己现在在招惹谁。这很危险。

lines.en: : {i}I will succeed where you have failed! No representation without compartmentalization!{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}你失败的地方，我会成功！无隔层，不代言！{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Also, why are you calling me? I’m at a party right now.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}还有，你为什么给我打电话？我现在在派对上。{/i}

lines.en: : I wanted to know if Akira is with you. He hasn’t been answering my texts.
lines.zh: : 我想知道 Akira 是不是跟你在一起。他一直不回我短信。

lines.en: : {i}Hm? He’s here. He’s not really “with” me, though. He’s kind of just doing his rounds and there’s nothing I can do but wait for my turn.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}嗯？他在啊。不过他不算「跟我在一起」。他就是在四处转悠，我除了等轮到自己之外什么也做不了。{/i}

lines.en: : How about being a little more proactive by going up to him and telling him that his beloved childhood friend would like to have a word?
lines.zh: : 那你就主动一点，走过去告诉他，他亲爱的青梅竹马想跟他说句话，怎么样？

lines.en: : {i}A word in regard to what, Onee-chan? If you would like to leave a message, please leave your name, number, a short description of the reason for your call, and the best time to reach you.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}关于什么的句话，Onee-chan？如果您要留言，请留下您的姓名、号码、来电事由简述，以及最方便联系您的时间。{/i}

lines.en: : Jennifer Aniston, 9-1-1, the results of his chlamydia test, and 2:34 AM. Thanks.
lines.zh: : Jennifer Aniston，9-1-1，他的衣原体检测结果，还有凌晨 2 点 34 分。谢了。

lines.en: : {i}It will be done! Goodbye, Onee-chan!{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}一定办到！再见，Onee-chan！{/i}

lines.en: : Wait, Noriko. I really-
lines.zh: : 等等，Noriko。我真的-

lines.en: scene nikotohahalloween2
: Tch. Fucking bitch. She didn’t even tell Akira I’ve been trying to reach him.
lines.zh: : 啧。操她妈的。她连我一直在找他都没跟 Akira 说。

lines.en: : I...guess he just doesn’t care about the results of his chlamydia test? I’m not really sure what I’m supposed to say here.
lines.zh: : 我……猜他只是不在乎自己的衣原体检测结果？我实在不确定这时候该说什么。

lines.en: scene nikotohahalloween3
: As my protege, you are supposed to simply nod and go along with everything I say or do. Which means you must now also hold a grudge against your teacher until the next time he screws me.
lines.zh: : 作为我的徒弟，你只需要点头，对我说的、做的一切都附和就行。也就是说，你现在也得跟着一起记恨你的老师，直到他下次再干我为止。

lines.en: : Which, hopefully, will be tonight as I’ve never had kinky Halloween sex before and I kind of want to do that.
lines.zh: : 希望就是今晚，因为我还没玩过变态的万圣节性爱，而且我有点想试试。

lines.en: : And this makes me a better singer...how?
lines.zh: : 这能让我歌唱得更好……怎么讲？

lines.en: : By...uhh...
scene nikotohahalloween4
: Being a singer is kind of like...being a receptionist.
lines.zh: : 当歌手有点像……当接待员。

lines.en: : You need to...think of what your fans and...the doctor...need out of you to...make it a...profession worth...
lines.zh: : 你需要……想想你的粉丝还有……医生……想从你这里得到什么，才能让它成为一份……有价值的……职业……

lines.en: scene nikotohahalloween5
: Just do what I fucking tell you to, okay?
lines.zh: : 我叫你干什么你就干什么，行吗？

lines.en: : I’ll get right on that, Princess Niki.
lines.zh: : 我这就去办，Niki 公主。

lines.en: : See? Was that so hard?
lines.zh: : 看吧？有那么难吗？

lines.en: : Cotton candy girl! Explain to me in seven words or less the method in which you command your childspawn!
lines.zh: : 棉花糖女孩！用七个字以内向我说明，你是怎么指挥你的幼崽的！

lines.en: scene nikotohahalloween6
: Otoha isn’t my childspawn. She’s just a clueless teenager I took under my wing because I’m a genius who can see the promise within her.
lines.zh: : Otoha 不是我的幼崽。她只是个没头没脑的少女，我把她收在羽翼之下，因为我是个能看见她身上潜质的天才。

lines.en: : So it is your job to provide the clues that will turn her into a life-detective?
lines.zh: : 所以你的职责就是提供线索，把她变成一个生活侦探？

lines.en: : Yeah, exactly.
lines.zh: : 对，正是。

lines.en: : Are we really sure “exactly” is the word we were supposed to use there?
lines.zh: : 我们真的确定这里该用的词是「正是」吗？

lines.en: : Why do you ask, Kaori? The miniature police-woman who’s been pacing back and forth all night isn’t actually your kid is she? You look too young. New employee maybe?
lines.zh: : 你问这个干嘛，Kaori？那个整晚走来走去的迷你女警察不是你孩子吧？你看着太年轻了。也许是新员工？

lines.en: scene nikotohahalloween7
: Nao-chan is no employee! Nor is she a child!
lines.zh: : Nao 酱才不是员工！她也不是孩子！

lines.en: : She is a mug monster who subsists primarily on her chosen diet of sugary milk soup Wednesday through Saturday and hamburger steak the other four nights of the week.
lines.zh: : 她是一只马克杯怪物，主要靠自己选择的食谱维生：周三到周六喝甜牛奶汤，一周其余四天吃汉堡排。

lines.en: : One...two...
: Whatever the case, I’m glad you’re not looking for tips on motherhood because I am {i}not{/i} the girl you want to ask. I’m never having kids.
lines.zh: : 不管怎样，我很高兴你不是在讨教当妈的经验，因为我{i}绝对{/i}不是你该问的人。我这辈子不生孩子。

lines.en: scene nikotohahalloween8
: Is it because your chosen mate’s sperms are ineffective? Or do you simply detest the sound of new life’s screams?
lines.zh: : 是因为你选定的配偶精子无效？还是你单纯厌恶新生命啼哭的声音？

lines.en: : Seven...eight? That’s too many days.
lines.zh: : 七……八？那天数也太多了。

lines.en: : Shut up, Otoha. The latter. Though I’d prefer the former so I could finally get rid of the birth control alarm on my phone.
lines.zh: : 闭嘴，Otoha。是后者。不过我倒希望是前者，这样我就能把手机上的避孕闹钟给删了。

lines.en: : What is the “birth control?”
lines.zh: : 「避孕」是什么？

lines.en: : You know how when you start to get a cold or whatever you can take, like...zinc tablets to amp up your antibodies to prepare yourself for it? It’s like that. Just the sickness is a child, which is {i}way{/i} worse.
lines.zh: : 你知道快感冒的时候，可以吃点……锌片什么的来增强抗体、提前预防吧？差不多就是这个意思。只不过那个「病」是个孩子，而且{i}要{/i}糟糕得多。

lines.en: : Will feeding this medicine to a child make it disappear?
lines.zh: : 把这种药喂给孩子，孩子就会消失吗？

lines.en: scene nikotohahalloween9
: Careful, Kaori. I’m pretty sure your childspawn thinks you’re trying to get rid of her.
lines.zh: : 小心点，Kaori。我敢肯定你的幼崽以为你想把她弄走。

lines.en: : Reduce your usage of exclamation points, Nao-chan. I would never get rid of you. I just want to know what to do if a child ever appears inside of my stretchy baby balloon.
lines.zh: : 少用点感叹号，Nao 酱。我永远不会弄走你。我只是想知道，万一有孩子出现在我的弹性婴儿气球里该怎么办。

lines.en: : Can we please not call it that?
lines.zh: : 我们能别这么叫它吗？

lines.en: scene nikotohahalloween10
: Yeah, I don’t think that’s a thing you need to worry about until you start having sex.
lines.zh: : 是啊，我觉得在你开始有性行为之前，根本不用担心这个。

lines.en: : And I would not have worried until recently! But a kiss happened and now I’m worried a sex will happen too!
lines.zh: : 我本来也不会担心的！可是发生了一个吻，现在我又担心会发生一次性行为！

lines.en: : You kissed someone? When? Who? I never heard about this.
lines.zh: : 你亲了谁？什么时候？谁啊？我从没听说过。

lines.en: scene nikotohahalloween11
: During nighttime! It was-
lines.zh: : 在夜里！是-

lines.en: : It was...
: Nao-chan!
lines.zh: : Nao 酱！

lines.en: scene nikotohahalloween12
: Uhh...I mean...I know you {i}said{/i} she’s not a child, but...
lines.zh: : 呃……我是说……我知道你{i}说过{/i}她不是孩子，不过……

lines.en: : W...What I meant by Nao-chan is...it wasn’t Nao-chan at all! It was...it...uhh...
lines.zh: : 我……我说 Nao 酱的意思是……根本不是 Nao 酱！是……是……呃……

lines.en: : A stranger!
lines.zh: : 一个陌生人！

lines.en: scene nikotohahalloween13
: You kissed a stranger so passionately that you think you two are going to fuck now? I didn’t realize you were like that, Kaori. But good for you, I guess.
lines.zh: : 你跟一个陌生人吻得那么激烈，以至于你觉得你们接下来就要上床了？我还不知道你是这种人呢，Kaori。不过，嘛，挺好的。

lines.en: scene nikotohahalloween14
: But it was not me who did the kissing! It was a me inside of me! A me who wanted to do the kissing while the me-me was on a brain vacation!
lines.zh: : 可是亲人的不是我！是我体内的另一个我！是那个在「我我」去大脑度假时想亲人的我！

lines.en: : Hey yeah. That’s what happened with me too, Niki. I’m not at fault at all.
lines.zh: : 对对。我也是这样的，Niki。我一点错都没有。

lines.en: : Shush. Kaori, what do you mean it was the “you inside of you?” Are you talking about your, like...conscience or whatever? That little voice that tells you what’s right and wrong?
lines.zh: : 嘘。Kaori，你说「你体内的你」是什么意思？你是说你的……良心什么的？那个告诉你什么是对错的小声音？

lines.en: : There is no little voice. Only a big one. Bigger than a tree in a glass room with special petals you can’t get from anywhere else.
lines.zh: : 没有小声音。只有一个大的。比玻璃房间里那棵树还大，树上开着别处弄不到的特殊花瓣。

lines.en: : Uh-huh. Go on.
lines.zh: : 嗯哼。接着说。

lines.en: : I just fear that the baby balloon is in danger of having its stretch function utilized if the not me-me craves a mate in the near future.
lines.zh: : 我只是担心，如果那个「不是我的我」在不久的将来渴望配偶，婴儿气球的拉伸功能就要被用上了。

lines.en: : Sorry to jump in again, but aren’t you in your twenties? Because that’s a puberty-thought and you seem a little behind schedule if you’re just getting those now.
lines.zh: : 抱歉又插话，不过你不是二十多岁了吗？因为那是青春期才会有的想法，你要是现在才冒出来，进度好像有点落后啊。

lines.en: : I don’t think that’s what Kaori means. I think she’s just...a little confused about romance and what to expect next. Which, honestly, is pretty damn fair.
lines.zh: : 我觉得 Kaori 不是那个意思。我觉得她只是……对恋爱和接下来会发生什么有点迷茫。说实话，这挺正常的。

lines.en: scene nikotohahalloween15
: Without beating around the bush, it’s that unexpectedness of love that makes it kind of {i}suck.{/i} But, weirdly enough, that’s also what makes it great.
lines.zh: : 直说了吧，正是爱情的这种不可预料，让它有点{i}糟{/i}。但奇怪的是，也正因为如此，它才美好。

lines.en: : Now, I’ve never made out with a stranger like you apparently have, but if that stranger is someone you want to spend more time with and neither of you {i}minds{/i} that the {i}not{/i} you-you wants to kiss...
lines.zh: : 我从没像你这样跟陌生人热吻过，不过如果那个陌生人是你想多待在一起的人，而且你们俩都{i}不介意{/i}那个「{i}不是{/i}你的你」想亲人的话……

lines.en: : I don’t see what the issue is. You like this person, right?
lines.zh: : 我看不出有什么问题。你喜欢这个人，对吧？

lines.en: : Yes! They are the only person I like on the kissing level. And a suitable candidate to procreate with should Nao-chan ever want a smaller sister.
lines.zh: : 是的！在接吻层面上，他们是我唯一喜欢的人。而且万一 Nao 酱哪天想要个妹妹，他们也是合适的生育对象。

lines.en: : Which she will not want for a long time according to her many dots.
lines.zh: : 看她这串点，估计她很长一段时间都不会想要。

lines.en: scene nikotohahalloween16
: Then don’t even worry about it, Kaori. All that baby stuff is something that comes way later on in relationships most of the time. And if all you’ve done is kiss, there’s nothing to worry about.
lines.zh: : 那就别担心了，Kaori。那些生孩子的事大多数时候都是感情到了很后面才会有的。而且你们只是亲了个吻，没什么好担心的。

lines.en: : Besides, focusing on stuff like that just fucks with your head and takes away from all the fun in the honeymoon stage of a relationship.
lines.zh: : 再说，总想着那些只会把你的脑子搞乱，还会夺走感情里蜜月期的全部乐趣。

lines.en: : H-Honeymoon?! Is the honeyed moon not the one that rises after saying “I am” at a traditional human wedding ceremony?! Does that come {i}before{/i} the balloon stretching?!
lines.zh: : 蜜……蜜月？！难道蜜月不是在传统人类婚礼上说出「我愿意」之后升起的那一轮月亮吗？！它是在气球拉伸{i}之前{/i}到来的吗？！

lines.en: : No, no — that’s not it. I just mean that when you’re in the earliest stages of liking someone, your brain wants to focus on that and {i}only{/i} that.
lines.zh: : 不，不是——不是那个意思。我是说，当你刚开始喜欢一个人的时候，你的脑子只想关注那件事，{i}只{/i}关注那件事。

lines.en: : You say things you would never say under normal circumstances...do things that {i}seem{/i} like good ideas in the moment but-
lines.zh: : 你会说出平时绝不会说的话……做出当下{i}看起来{/i}是个好主意的事，但-

lines.en: : {i}Ahem.{/i}
scene nikotohahalloween17
: But are actually extremely fucking stupid and will torment you every time you look back on them from that point onward.
lines.zh: : 但那些事实际上蠢得要命，从此以后每次回想起来都会折磨你。

lines.en: : At what stage in my training do I learn the part of singing where I can start pointedly saying things about people I’m with without directly revealing to them that they’re the one I’m talking about?
lines.zh: : 在我的训练里，要到哪个阶段才能学会唱歌里的这一项——开始指桑骂槐地说身边人的事，却不让他们知道我说的就是他们？

lines.en: scene nikotohahalloween18
: That has nothing to do with singing. That’s just part of being a girl.
lines.zh: : 那跟唱歌没关系。那是做女生的一部分。

lines.en: : Nao-chan! Come with me to the oven-room!
lines.zh: : Nao 酱！跟我来烤箱房！

lines.en: : The not me-me has warned me that an important conversation is about to happen and if we continue to stand here, important vibrations will bounce off of us!
lines.zh: : 「不是我的我」警告过我，一场重要的对话即将发生，我们要是继续站在这里，重要的振动就会从我们身上弹开！

lines.en: : I think that’s our cue.
lines.zh: : 我觉得这是在提示我们。

lines.en: scene nikotohahalloween19
: Our cue to what?
lines.zh: : 提示我们干什么？

lines.en: : I don’t know...{i}talk{/i} maybe?
lines.zh: : 我不知道……也许{i}聊聊{/i}？

lines.en: : About what? Our tribute livestream went pretty well tonight. We could talk about that?
lines.zh: : 聊什么？我们今晚的致敬直播挺成功的。可以聊聊那个？

lines.en: : You know that’s not what I mean.
lines.zh: : 你知道我不是那个意思。

lines.en: : Of course I know that. I’m not a fucking moron, Otoha.
lines.zh: : 我当然知道。我又不是白痴，Otoha。

lines.en: : This smile is me giving you chance after chance to change the topic because you’re not going to like literally anything I have to say about this and I want to preserve our current relationship.
lines.zh: : 我这个笑容，是在一次又一次给你换话题的机会，因为我接下来说的任何话你都不会爱听，而我想保住我们现在的关系。

lines.en: scene nikotohahalloween20
: Am I wrong in thinking our “current relationship” is one where we can talk about our feelings and, like...try to resolve them or whatever?
lines.zh: : 我以为我们的「现在的关系」是那种可以聊聊彼此的感受，然后……试着解决问题什么的，我这么想错了吗？

lines.en: : Yeah. You are. Plus, you already {i}have{/i} a relationship like that. And I’d be willing to put money on the fact that you haven’t talked about this with her yet, have you?
lines.zh: : 对。你错了。再说，你早就{i}有{/i}那样的关系了。而且我敢打赌，你还没跟她谈过这件事，对吧？

lines.en: : {i}Her?{/i} No. I have no idea where I’d even start.
lines.zh: : {i}她？{/i}没有。我完全不知道该从哪儿开口。

lines.en: : Would you mind explaining what the emphasis on {i}“her”{/i} was for right there? Because that made it sound like you’ve told somebody else and that would be a very, {i}very{/i} stupid thing to do, Otoha.
lines.zh: : 你能解释一下刚才那个{i}「她」{/i}的重音是什么意思吗？因为那听起来像是你告诉了别人，而那会是件非常、{i}非常{/i}蠢的事，Otoha。

lines.en: : I told Sensei.
lines.zh: : 我告诉 Sensei 了。

lines.en: scene nikotohahalloween21
: You did {i}what?!{/i}
lines.zh: : 你{i}干了什么？！{/i}

lines.en: : N-Not that it was you specifically! Just that I kissed somebody else! I wanted to hear what he thought about it because he’s the king of bad decisions and-
lines.zh: : 不……不是说是你！只是说我亲了别人！我想听听他的看法，因为他是烂决定的大王，而且-

lines.en: scene nikotohahalloween22
: Otoha, for the love of fucking {i}God,{/i} please quash this childish crush of yours before it becomes even more of a burden than it already is. For {i}both{/i} of us.
lines.zh: : Otoha，看在{i}上帝{/i}他妈的份上，请你掐掉这份幼稚的迷恋，别让它变得比现在更沉重。为了我们{i}两个人{/i}。

lines.en: : Do you think I {i}want{/i} to feel like this? Hell no. But I do. And you’re the one who literally just said that it’s during times like this where we do stupid shit and...say stupid things.
lines.zh: : 你觉得我{i}想{/i}有这种感觉吗？当然不想。可我确实有。而且刚才亲口说「人在这个时候会做蠢事、说蠢话」的，不就是你吗。

lines.en: : Which is why I so kindly dropped the fact that you ever kissed me in the first place. But it’s hard to qualify repeated offenses as impulsive decisions and it’s starting to feel like this is calculated.
lines.zh: : 所以我才好心把你吻过我这件事翻篇不提。但一再犯同样的错，就很难再被归为一时冲动了，而且我开始觉得这是有预谋的。

lines.en: : Calculated? What’s that supposed to mean?
lines.zh: : 有预谋？你这话是什么意思？

lines.en: scene nikotohahalloween23
: What do you want out of this? What do you expect to happen?
lines.zh: : 你想从这中间得到什么？你指望会发生什么？

lines.en: : Do you want me to just...drop the love I’ve held {i}forever{/i} and hook up with a high-school girl instead? Do you not realize how ridiculous that sounds?
lines.zh: : 你想让我就这么……丢掉我{i}一辈子{/i}都在守着的爱，转头去跟一个高中女生在一起？你难道不觉得这听起来有多荒唐吗？

lines.en: : Not really. But maybe I’m just jaded and easily influenced by what other influential adults around me seem to do when it comes to high-school girls.
lines.zh: : 不觉得。不过也许我只是太愤世嫉俗，又太容易被身边那些有影响力的成年人对高中女生做的事影响。

lines.en: : Watch your fucking mouth, Otoha. I’m not an idiot. I know what you meant by that.
lines.zh: : 说话给我注意点，Otoha。我不是傻子。我知道你那话什么意思。

lines.en: scene nikotohahalloween24
: Niki...when I’m with you, I-
lines.zh: : Niki……和你在一起的时候，我-

lines.en: : You what? Get fucking butterflies? Can’t think straight? Imagine a life where the two of us can continue to do our own thing, but hop into one another’s arms whenever we get home?
lines.zh: : 你什么？小鹿乱撞？没法正常思考？想象着这样的人生——我们各自做各自的事，但一回到家就扑进对方怀里？

lines.en: : And it {i}won’t matter{/i} if it’s behind a curtain or anything like that because it can be “just for us” and it “won’t be weird” since “age is only a number” and blah blah blah I’m a horny fucking teenager.
lines.zh: : 而且就算是在帘子后面什么的也{i}无所谓{/i}，因为那可以「只属于我们」、「不会奇怪」，毕竟「年龄只是个数字」，诸如此类的废话，我是个饥渴的死小孩。

lines.en: scene nikotohahalloween25
: Do you really think you’re the first teenage girl who’s ever developed “feelings” for me? Because, I hate to break to it to you, Otoha, but this isn’t exactly {i}new.{/i}
lines.zh: : 你真以为你是第一个对我产生「感情」的少女吗？我可不想打击你，Otoha，但这{i}一点都不新鲜{/i}。

lines.en: : Granted, you’re the first who’s ever actually succeeded in kissing me, though. So kudos to you for that, I guess. God forbid I let my guard down for a single fucking second in my own fucking dressing room.
lines.zh: : 不过话说回来，你是第一个真的亲到我的。所以，嘛，这点算你厉害。但愿别让我在自己他妈的更衣室里松懈哪怕一秒钟。

lines.en: : I’m {i}sorry{/i} for that, okay? I got caught up in the mood and-
lines.zh: : 我为那件事{i}道歉{/i}，行吗？我当时沉浸在氛围里，而且-

lines.en: : Of course you got “caught up in the mood.” My whole job...my whole {i}life{/i} has been dedicated to {i}creating{/i} that mood for fucking years now. That’s what it means to be an {i}idol.{/i}
lines.zh: : 你当然会「沉浸在氛围里」。我的整个工作……我的整个人{i}生{/i}，这么多年来都是为了{i}制造{/i}那种氛围。这就是当{i}偶像{/i}的意义。

lines.en: : You’re supposed to love me and fantasize about me and look up to me because that’s what keeps this industry afloat. And without impulsive, stupid girls like you, it would all come crumbling down.
lines.zh: : 你们本就该爱我、对我抱有幻想、仰视我，因为正是这些让这行撑下去。要是没有你这种冲动又愚蠢的女孩，这一切都会土崩瓦解。

lines.en: : But the honest truth is that none of you know the first thing about me and, if you did, you’d realize I’m just as much of a fucking project as anybody else.
lines.zh: : 可老实说，你们没有一个人真正了解我；要是真了解了，你们就会意识到，我跟其他人一样是个他妈的烂摊子。

lines.en: : Plus, I’m pretty sure I’m only mentally capable of loving one person for the rest of my life because someone somewhere cursed me or some shit. And, news-flash, that person is {i}definitely{/i} not you.
lines.zh: : 再说，我很确定我这辈子在精神上只能爱上一个人，大概是哪个地方的谁给我下了诅咒还是什么的。而，剧透一下，那个人{i}绝对{/i}不是你。

lines.en: : Nor is it any of the other trillion girls out there who’ve sent me love letters or hung on too long at handshake events or snuck backstage to try and “tell me how they feel.”
lines.zh: : 也不是外面那万亿个给我写情书、在握手会上赖着不走、或者溜到后台想「告诉我她们的感受」的女孩。

lines.en: : Every single one of you has fallen for the trap laid out by my producers. That’s all this is. It isn’t {i}love.{/i} You’re just an idiot.
lines.zh: : 你们每一个人都掉进了我的制作人布下的陷阱。就是这样而已。这不是{i}爱{/i}。你只是个蠢货。

lines.en: : Are you done now? Can I say something?
lines.zh: : 你说完了吗？我能说点什么吗？

lines.en: : That depends on what it is you want to say.
lines.zh: : 那要看你想说什么。

lines.en: : Do you really think I’m the same as everyone else?
lines.zh: : 你真觉得我跟其他人一样？

lines.en: : In regard to your feelings for me? Oh yeah. You’re not even remotely different. It’s your {i}talent{/i} that separates you from the others.
lines.zh: : 就你对我的感情而言？哦，当然。你一点都不特别。让你和别人拉开差距的是你的{i}才华{/i}。

lines.en: : But the reason I spend so much time on you has {i}everything{/i} to do with that and {i}nothing{/i} to do with anything “personal.”
lines.zh: : 而我之所以在你身上花这么多时间，{i}完全{/i}是因为这个，跟任何「私人」的东西{i}一点关系都没有{/i}。

lines.en: : And you don’t think it’s at all possible that I started feeling this way about you {i}because{/i} of all that extra time you spend on me?
lines.zh: : 你就不觉得，我之所以会对你产生这种感觉，{i}是因为{/i}你花在我身上的那些额外时间吗？

lines.en: scene nikotohahalloween26

: I don’t give a shit {i}why{/i} or {i}how{/i} you started feeling this way about me. I just know that it puts me in a weird fucking spot and that I {i}don’t{/i} think of you that way and that I want it to stop.
lines.zh: : 我才不在乎你是{i}为什么{/i}、{i}怎么{/i}开始对我有这种感觉的。我只知道这把我推到了一个非常他妈尴尬的境地，我{i}没有{/i}那种想法，而且我想让它停下来。

lines.en: : Now, a question for you — do you want to work in this industry at all, Otoha? Or are you only taking lessons from me because you hoped you’d have a shot at my “love?” Which, again, you don’t.
lines.zh: : 现在换我问你——你到底想不想在这行干下去，Otoha？还是你跟我上课只是为了有机会得到我的「爱」？再说一遍，你没有。

lines.en: : I...do. Want to work in this industry, I mean. Or...at least I think I do. I’m not really sure yet.
lines.zh: : 我……想。我是说，想在这行干。或者……至少我觉得想。我还不太确定。

lines.en: : That’s fine. You don’t {i}need{/i} to be sure at your age. Lord knows I wasn’t.
lines.zh: : 没关系。你这个年纪{i}不需要{/i}确定。老天知道我当时也不确定。

lines.en: : But you’ve gotta get your head on straight and stop spending all this time thinking about extra shit. You’ve gotta stop thinking about {i}me.{/i}
lines.zh: : 但你得把脑子摆正，别再把时间都花在这些乱七八糟的事上。你得停止想{i}我{/i}。

lines.en: : Stop thinking about {i}everything{/i} other than music if you really want to make it. Your personal life is nothing more than a distraction. Hone your skills now, have feelings {i}later.{/i}
lines.zh: : 要是真想出头，就别去想音乐以外的{i}任何事{/i}。你的私人生活不过是一种干扰。现在磨炼技艺，{i}以后{/i}再去谈感情。

lines.en: : Then, once you’re the best, you can start complaining about how love sucks. And {i}you{/i} can be the one rejecting the advances of a bunch of teenagers who want you to finger them. The end.
lines.zh: : 等你成了最好的那个，你就可以开始抱怨爱情有多烂了。然后{i}你{/i}就能成为那个拒绝一堆想让你用手指弄她们的少女的人。完了。

lines.en: : And now you’re sad. See? I told you this wasn’t a thing you wanted to talk about.
lines.zh: : 现在你难过了。看吧？我说过这话题你不会想聊的。

lines.en: : I know. But I...feel like we kind of had to.
lines.zh: : 我知道。但我……觉得我们多少非谈不可。

lines.en: scene nikotohahalloween27
: I still think I’m a little different from everyone else you’re trying to compare me to. But if you’re that against the idea of ever being with me, I won’t bring it up again.
lines.zh: : 我还是觉得，我跟你拿来比较的那些人多少有点不一样。但如果你这么抗拒跟我在一起的可能，我不会再提了。

lines.en: : Maybe you’re right. Maybe all of this personal shit {i}is{/i} a distraction and I need to...start ignoring all of that if I really want a shot. Maybe that’s true.
lines.zh: : 也许你是对的。也许这些私人的破事{i}确实{/i}是种干扰，而我得……开始无视这一切，如果我真想有出息的话。也许真是这样。

lines.en: : I just hoped I’d be able to do both. To enjoy my life {i}and{/i} work toward the future.
lines.zh: : 我只是希望两样都能做到。既享受生活，{i}又{/i}为未来努力。

lines.en: : Well, in my shitty experience, it’s either one or the other. And if that doesn’t align with your core beliefs, maybe you need to find another instructor.
lines.zh: : 嗯，以我糟糕的经验来看，二者只能选其一。要是这跟你的核心信念不符，也许你该另找一位老师。

lines.en: scene nikotohahalloween28
: Well, maybe it’s just the apparently-manufactured desire for you to take my clothes off speaking, but I’m pretty sure it has to be you if I’m going to have a real shot at success.
lines.zh: : 嗯，也许是那个「被制造出来的、想让你脱掉我衣服的欲望」在说话，但我很确定，如果我想真正有机会成功，那个人必须是你。

lines.en: : You won’t have any shot at all if you keep saying shit like that, Otoha. Believe in {i}yourself{/i} and cast aside anyone else who gets in the way. {i}That’s{/i} what it takes to make it today.
lines.zh: : 你要是继续说这种话，一点机会都不会有，Otoha。相信{i}你自己{/i}，把所有挡路的人都抛开。{i}那才{/i}是今天这行出头的方式。

lines.en: : That and a lot of heartache.
lines.zh: : 还有，大量的心痛。

lines.en: : If that’s what needs to be done, it will be done.
lines.zh: : 如果非这样不可，那就这样吧。

lines.en: scene nikotohahalloween29
: I return!
lines.zh: : 我回来了！

lines.en: scene nikotohahalloween30
: With another serving of {i}justice.{/i}
lines.zh: : 又一份{i}正义{/i}来了。

lines.en: : And on that note, the swap back into {i}fun{/i} Niki begins! Are you going to finish your weiner festival, Otoha?
lines.zh: : 那么，切换回{i}好玩的{/i} Niki 模式开始！你的香肠大会还要吃完吗，Otoha？

lines.en: scene nikotohahalloween31
: Sacrilege! Call the food item by its correct name!
lines.zh: : 亵渎！请用正确的名字称呼这种食物！

lines.en: : Nah. I’ve had enough penis party for today. You can have the rest.
lines.zh: : 算了。今天的小鸡鸡派对我已经受够了。剩下的归你。

lines.en: scene nikotohahalloween32
: That one is even worse! Your decision to rent my services and building for the day are suddenly very confusing to me if all you are going to do is play games!
lines.zh: : 这个更过分！如果你们一整天只打算玩游戏，那你们租下我的服务和场地这件事，突然让我非常费解！

lines.en: scene black
: Ooooh do you have any games? What else can we do around here? I want to do something fun tonight and I’m not trying to put on another dolphin costume.
lines.zh: : 哦哦，你们有游戏吗？这附近还能玩什么？我今晚想找点乐子，而且我可不想再穿一次海豚装了。

lines.en: : Nao-chan wants to know what a “dolphin” is.
lines.zh: : Nao 酱想知道「海豚」是什么。

lines.en: : It’s like a big fish that fucks with other fish. Also, where the hell did you get this girl and why doesn’t she know about dolphins yet?
lines.zh: : 就是一种会跟别的鱼乱搞的大鱼。还有，你到底从哪儿弄来这姑娘的，她怎么到现在还不知道海豚？

lines.en: : I’m afraid that is a question for someone much bigger than me...
lines.zh: : 恐怕这个问题得去问一个比我大得多的人……
